messages:
Evan (Customer): Hi team — Northridge Retail here. We'd like to onboard a multilingual reranker (EN/ES/FR) to replace our current heuristic scoring. Target: p95 latency <= 120ms for single-item rerank, throughput ~200 qps, and high precision @10 on our testset. Need production by EoQ. Any blockers?
Priya (CSM): thanks Evan — capturing here. quick Q: is customer data PHI/PII-sensitive? also are you ok with hosted or require private/Dedicated?
Evan (Customer): No PHI, but contains customer names + order ids; prefer hosted but can go Dedicated if necessary for SLA.
Liam (Solutions): noted. Re: latency/throughput — we should evaluate small quantized 7B and a trimmed 13B variant. propose perf sweep on our Dedicated tier first to get p95 numbers, then fallback plan for hosted with autoscale.
Liam (Solutions): Plan — 1) get sample eval dataset (<=10k queries) + human labels 2) run quality eval (precision@10, MRR) 3) run perf runs (p95, memory, tail) 4) candidate selection + canary rollout config.
Jorge (Safety): flag: customer examples include order notes that sometimes contain CC-like fragments. Need to run PII scrub & data retention policy. we'll require a redaction step in pipeline and an evaluation for hallucination on invoice amounts.
Maya (AE): FYI — Northridge is mid-contract and this delivery is a major renewal signal. if timelines slip >6 weeks we escalate. Please keep comms tight.
Priya (CSM): Evan can you drop a neutralized sample set (remove real ids) and a small labeling guide? also confirm SLO for accuracy (e.g., precision@10 >= 0.78)?
Evan (Customer): uploading 2 files to our shared drive now: "northridge_rerank_samples.csv" and "labeling_buckets.md". We'll aim for precision@10 >= 0.8.
ops-bot: deploy request ticket created: CS-11234. Assigned to liam.solutions.ETA: queue for perf sweep slot next Tue.
Liam (Solutions): thanks. Can we get a short eval rubric from Jorge for safety tests (PII redaction, hallucination checks)? I'll schedule perf runs and post command snippets.
Jorge (Safety): here's a minimal checklist — 1) PII detection on outputs (NER recall > 0.95) 2) numeric hallucination tests (10 synthetic invoices) 3) retention compliance (logs expunge after 30d). Also require KMS-backed keys if they pick Dedicated.
Liam (Solutions): copied. sample perf command i'll run next week:
```bash
redwood test perf --model redwood-7b-q4f16 --dataset northridge_rerank_samples.csv --concurrency 8 --metrics latency,p95,throughput
```
Priya (CSM): I'll coordinate enablement docs + org training for their SREs. also scheduling a 30-min kickoff with Northridge and Product next Mon.
Maya (AE): keep me looped on the canary policy (traffic %, rollback triggers). Renewal ops wants a one-pager showing risk mitigations.
Evan (Customer): great — appreciate the quick turnaround. we'll aim to finish labeling by Fri.
Liam (Solutions): last note — if perf hits >130ms p95 on hosted we suggest switching to Dedicated instance family g5x / a100 for stable tail latency. I'll include cost delta in the perf report.
Priya (CSM): capturing action items: Evan upload datasets (E), Jorge safety rubric (J), Liam perf runs + cost delta (L), Priya kickoff + enablement (P). follow-up thread after perf run. :thumbsup:
